messages:
Maria Chen: quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

maria: Did: landed the gateway route matcher fix (PR merged), updated canary rules so token auth is evaluated before rate policy. Verified smoke in staging.

maria: Blocker: noticed flaky 429 spike when we ramp concurrent streaming calls in staging — unclear if it's batching windows or policy evaluation.

maria: Today: pair with @Chris to trace the 429s, add metric for policy eval latency, and open a rollback toggle in config if needed.

Chris Patel: Thanks — I can join pair at 11:30 PT. I skimmed the PR, looks good. I can add a quick latency histogram in the gateway.

Samir Rao: FYI I rebuilt the dedicated pool autoscaler test harness yesterday, can run a load profile that reproduces the spike. Samir: sending link to runbook after this thread.

Anya Lopez: Noted — I pushed a tiny tweak to the jwt middleware yesterday to cache parsed keys for 10s. Should reduce CPU on auth path; will monitor.

Maria Chen: @Samir please run the load with streaming clients + small prompt sizes — I saw higher token throughput amplify 429s.

Samir Rao: Will do. Quick heads-up: if it's kv-cache pressure we might see degraded tail latency rather than throughput drop. I'll capture p95/p99.

Chris Patel: For tracing — can we add a span around policy evaluation and annotate which policy branch (prefix-match, jwt, rate) was taken? That should show hot path.

Anya Lopez: Yup. I can add a span in middleware; will push a small change and flag in Telemetry.

Maria Chen: If we get a reproducer, we should try two mitigations: 1) increase batching window slightly in staging to smooth bursts, 2) short-circuit rate check for trusted internal clients. We'll discuss fallback policy.

deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-mw-caching v2 -> staging (build #8972) :rocket:

Chris Patel: Nice. After the tracing span is in, I'll run Samir's load and collect traces. If policy eval is the culprit we can consider caching policy decisions for identical request fingerprints for ~50ms.

Anya Lopez: pushed span + small cache PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pull/2568 — please review.

Maria Chen: Reviewing now. Also opened a quick feature flag: `gw.ratepolicy.short_circuit` set to false in staging. If needed I can flip to true to reduce calls to full policy engine.

Samir Rao: Load started (link: https://perf.internal/runs/9387). Initial run shows p99 token latency spike ~2.1s when concurrent streams >120.

Chris Patel: Traces look like long policy eval + syscall wait when HTTP keepalive churns. Might be connection churn. I'll try bumping keepalive timeouts in a canary.

Maria Chen: Good call. Add note to rollback checklist: keepalive timeout change and feature-flag flip.

Anya Lopez: I also enabled a short TTL on the parsed-jwt cache to avoid stale key issues. Observability: added a metric `auth.parsed_jwt_cache_hit` so we can correlate.

Chris Patel: After Samir's next run I'll post a short summary. If we still see spikes, let's schedule a 30m sync right after lunch.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. No blockers on other items today. I'll follow up with a summary and the rollback steps if we need them. :thumbsup:
